dedupe_keys.name: wfp number of people reached with food assistance in emergency settings 2017 level 2 and level 3 emergencies

description: This dataset counts the people reached with WFP food assistance in its emergency operations. The figures were collected from WFP situation reports and emergency dashboards and published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange, where the dataset is tagged to 29 countries including Syria, Yemen, South Sudan, Nigeria, Iraq, Ethiopia, Ukraine and the Sahel and southern African countries. Two Excel files are available, from data collections in April and May 2017, and the file names suggest they cover WFP's Level 2 and Level 3 emergencies. Files are free to download without registration under a Creative Commons Attribution licence for intergovernmental organisations (CC BY-IGO). Caveats: HDX warns that monthly figures must not be summed over time because the same people can be assisted in several months, the files cover only spring 2017, and the dataset has not been updated since. Simulation uses: scale of emergency food distribution by country for calibrating relief logistics and food assistance demand in humanitarian response models. Related records: the WFP nutritious supply chain optimisation (case_study-wfp-nutritious-supply-chain-optimisation) shows how such operations are planned, and IPC acute food insecurity data (data-ipc-acute-food-insecurity-country-data) give needs.
